name: Tina Cote
occupation: Former Weston County clerk of district court (won the November 2022 general election; the News Letter Journal reported that she resigned effective December 31, after which the board appointed her deputy, Riki Kaiser, on February 4, 2025)
prior_offices: Weston County clerk of district court (won the November 2022 general election; resigned effective December 31, 2024, as reported in connection with the February 4, 2025, appointment)
background: Tina Cote served as Weston County clerk of district court after winning the November 2022 general election. The News Letter Journal reported that the Board of Weston County Commissioners appointed her deputy, Riki Kaiser, on February 4, 2025, to the position left vacant on Cote's December 31 resignation. Official February 4, 2025, commissioners minutes record the motion appointing Kaiser as clerk of district court.
